purpose: Personal compatibility fork for Actual Budget 26.10.0
patch_scope: Pin Actual API 26.10.0; Node >=22; portable upstream test launcher; preserve opaque passwords; synthetic tests and artifact-only build. No npm publication. Budget reads and writes preserve all existing or unset feature preferences; remove automatic feature defaults.
validation: See GitHub Actions for results tied to the exact commit. Tests use disposable synthetic budgets only.
maintenance: Monitor upstream releases; rebase the minimal patch and repeat compatibility tests before adopting changes. No assertion that upstream is abandoned.
known_behavior: Feature preferences are left to Actual and explicit user changes. Normal configured server synchronization still applies; this does not make all native read operations side-effect-free.
